text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: high 5xx rate (>= 18%) for tenant=CypherCorp in VPC=cypher-prod-us-east, affected pool=dedicated-cypher-01. Escalation level: P1. Paging on-call SRE. Link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/3912345678 :rotating_light:

jamie: on it. seeing spikes starting ~00:12 UTC. error signature looks like KV cache miss + timeout downstream to model runtime. logs: `batch_exec timeout after 1200ms` and GPU OOMs interleaved.

emily: cypher customer success here — CypherCorp reports latency spikes on their production customer-facing feature. They're seeing ~30% of requests 5xx and are asking for immediate mitigation.

jamie: preliminary triage: requests for tenant pin=cypher-v1.4 are getting routed to a mixed-quant variant on dedicated pool. suspect quant path regression + heavier batch sizes.

rachel: tagging in runtime. can you paste the last 10 model loads for that pool? I can check kernel selection and quant fallback counters.

jamie: pasted snippet from logs (sanitized):
```
[00:11:48] load model cypher-v1.4-quant32 -> selected kernel set A
[00:12:03] batch_exec ts=1200ms id=abc123 -> OOM on worker-7
[00:12:05] fallback to cypher-v1.4-quant16 attempted
[00:12:07] continuous batching window enlarged -> batch size 32
[00:12:08] kv-cache miss ratio spike -> 0.47
[00:12:12] request timeout -> 504 to client
```

arjun: is there a safe variant we can switch to for CypherCorp while we debug? they'd prefer a quick, conservative fix.

rachel: yes — ops has a verified safe variant: `cypher-v1.4-safe` (fp16, smaller cache footprint, validated latency profile). It has slightly lower throughput but no quant-specific regression. We can pin the tenant to that variant or route just CypherCorp to hosted fallback.

maya: two options with tradeoffs:
- Quick pin: update tenant routing to `model_pin: cypher-v1.4-safe` for the tenant route. Changes take effect in ~30s and avoid the problematic quant kernels. Customer requests still go to their dedicated pool but with safe variant.
- Fast failover: route tenant to hosted pool `redwood-hosted-safes` with same model. That offloads their load from the dedicated pool entirely (will increase their latency slightly but reduces 5xx rate).

jamie: I'm going to apply a temporary tenant pin first (preferred by CS). will do the API call and watch for error rate drop. tagging @deploy-bot for audit.

deploy-bot: Deploy lock check: allowed for oncall SRE. Audit ID will be generated.

jamie: executing now:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/tenants/cyphercorp/routing \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFW_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model_pin":"cypher-v1.4-safe", "rollout":"immediate", "note":"temporary mitigation - P1 active"}'
```

jamie: API returned 200. Audit ID: audit_8f7c. Monitoring..

rachel: watching kernels and kv-cache metrics. initial drop in OOMs. batch sizes auto-decreased by runtime. kv-cache miss down to 0.12 now.

jamie: client 5xx rate down from 30% -> 4.3% in 2 minutes. Good sign.

emily: relaying to CypherCorp: "We applied a temporary model pin to a safer variant; this should reduce errors within minutes. We're continuing root cause analysis and will advise next steps."

arjun: customer asks how long this mitigation can remain. any side-effects?

rachel: safe to keep pinned for hours-days while we investigate. throughput impact ~15% for CypherCorp spike workloads. No data plane changes. Recommend keeping pin until runtime team finishes kernel/quant regression revert and we validate.

maya: next steps (owners):
- jamie (oncall): keep mitigation active and monitor 30m window for regression. escalate if 5xx > 10% again.
- rachel (runtime): run bisect on recent kernel/quant commits in the next 2 hours. try repro with load harness.
- emily/arjun (CS): notify CypherCorp PM/Eng with status and ETA ~2-4h for RCA.
- maya (platform): prepare hosted fallback route in case we need to failover the tenant completely.

jamie: adding temporary incident tag and status: mitigation=applied, severity=P1 -> monitoring.

rachel: discovered a suspect kernel change in staging: commit sha abcdef123 changed fused-attn dispatch for quant16. starting a targeted rollback test.

deploy-bot: Noted rollback test scheduled by rachel: rollout_id rb-2026-07-12-01. do not perform global rollback without approval from eng-runtime lead.

emily: CypherCorp acknowledged mitigation and asked for a short postmortem once RCA complete. They also requested an option to opt into hosted fallback during business hours automatically if errors spike again.

maya: we have a policy config for tenant auto-failover. ops+sales signoff required for cost/latency tradeoff. filing a ticket with template `TKT-ops-cypher-auto-failover`.

jamie: monitoring stable for now. i'll hand off to rachel for deep dive. oncall remains assigned until 30m mark.

rachel: thanks. initial blame points to the quant kernel dispatch path; will follow up in this thread with RCA and recommended long-term remediation (patch vs revert vs model re-quant).

jamie: closing active paging loop; incident-bot please annotate alert as mitigated by tenant pin.

incident-bot: Alert 3912345678 annotated: mitigation=tenant_pin; status=under_observation. If 5xx rises above threshold, incident will auto-escalate. :white_check_mark:
